prompt:
Author ONE production isometric RPG game-animation sprite sheet: SIX independently articulated HIT-REACTION poses of exactly the original 지배자 기르타스 (Girtas), ALL facing SOUTH-EAST, screen LOWER-RIGHT, FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view. Use ONLY the attached original portrait and faithful canonical identity references, plus the optional explicitly described rear guide. Preserve the PALE VISIBLE FACE in views where it is anatomically visible, LONG PALE/WHITE HAIR, exact gold head structure, THIN NARROW HARD-GOLD RADIAL SPINES, dark gold-trimmed armor and LONG DARK GOLD-TRIMMED SKIRT, original boots, and ONE LONG SINUOUS ORIGINAL GLOWING WEAPON. No red mask or substitute demon face, no short-skirt armor redesign, no broad replacement wings, no extra weapon or new anatomy. Preserve exact original head/torso/feet proportions and material identity. 

ABSOLUTE DIRECTION IS DECISIVE: ALL SIX have SOUTH-EAST, screen LOWER-RIGHT, FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view. The pale visible face, front chest armor, hips and toes aim distinctly DOWN-RIGHT toward the viewer. Do not turn to horizontal EAST or rear-right. The original anatomical RIGHT weapon arm is the near/lower-left side of this front-right body, with the original blade readable toward IMAGE LEFT. The other hand stays unarmed. Helmet/head, shoulders, chest/back, pelvis and toes all agree with that exact compass direction through the ENTIRE sequence. Keep the same elevated orthographic isometric camera. Reaction changes PITCH, neck/shoulder/elbow/hip/knee articulation and stance, never the body YAW/facing. Do not turn into a front pose, north pose, opposite side or easier neighboring direction at maximum recoil. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the same single long sinuous weapon throughout; any necessary real perspective occlusion must remain coherent rather than switching the weapon hand. Never mirror a different direction.

Six real chronological bodily impact phases in left-to-right then down order: (0) stable brace in the requested facing, feet supporting weight and original weapon held low; (1) impact from an unseen enemy directly IN FRONT of the character along the requested heading jolts torso/shoulders/head BACKWARD, knees begin flexing and free arm counterbalances; (2) MAXIMUM actual torso/head/shoulder recoil with coherent neck/spine/hips and articulated knees, pale hair and long skirt lag physically while exact requested body heading is unchanged; (3) a balanced stagger and counterstep of the original feet, one foot bears weight and the other braces back, original hips/knees/ankles recover balance without extra limbs or a side turn; (4) recover torso over the supporting feet, arms/hair/skirt settle; (5) controlled recovered guard in exactly the same compass heading, a distinct settling pose. In rear views show only back helmet/hair/armor, never a front face or front chest emblem during recoil. Keep the original weapon low and non-offensive; this is HIT reaction, NOT an attack slash, death, bow or weapon flourish. Six true independently drawn joint/body responses, not repeated poses, global translation/rotation, tint/opacity changes, camera movement, motion blur or ornamental glow substitution.

Technical MINIATURE atlas:1024x1536 PNG, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, SIX512x512 cells. ONE complete character in each cell. Aim for about280-300px helmet-to-boots body and full silhouette at most330x330px INCLUDING every narrow gold needle tip, full long curved blade and tip, hair, long skirt and boots. Keep each in its central330x330 area with at least91px completely empty transparent gutter on EVERY cell edge. More than70percent of the page stays empty. DO NOT enlarge figures to fill the page. Same actual head/torso/feet pixel scale in all six. Re-angle attached existing equipment coherently; never crop, shorten, omit, detach, or shrink one pose. No character bounding-rectangle overlap or cross-cell glow/blur.

Detailed crisp game cutouts, readable pale hair/face where appropriate, gold trim and fully opaque dark armor/skirt. Gold/fire brightness stays inside the original real solid chest/weapon/spine surfaces; no diffuse outer glow. Alpha0 outside exact silhouettes and in all gaps, edge antialiasing only1-2pixels. No floor, shadows, scene, background panels, bloom, haze, fog, halo, dust, lightning trails, text, labels, numbers, grid, spare parts or extra figures. Final sheet must show SIX genuine readable HIT responses of the faithful original Girtas in the exact requested SE compass direction, retaining the original single weapon in the same anatomical RIGHT hand.

visual_findings: Absolute compass: all six keep SOUTH-EAST/front-right DOWN-RIGHT heading, with pale front-right facial surfaces and original front chest armor visible. This is distinct from the horizontal EAST side profile and from rear-right/back view.

Phase0 braces; phases1-2 pitch the torso/head back toward upper-left opposite the incoming front-right hit, with maximum genuine chest/neck recoil at2 while yaw stays front-right. The free arm, hips and knees visibly articulate rather than translating the whole figure.

Phase3 adopts a balanced bent-knee stagger/counterstep; phase4 brings the torso back over the feet; phase5 settles into the same front-right guard. Long hair/skirt lag follows the body and all six drawings are distinct.
Anatomical RIGHT weapon hand remains at near/image-left side and holds the same one full long sinuous original blade low, without an attacking slash or hand swap. The image-right hand stays unarmed.

Pale visible face, long pale hair, original gold head structure, narrow hard-gold radial spines, long dark gold-trimmed skirt/armor and original boots remain faithful. No red mask, broad replacement wing or short-skirt redesign.

Strict direct source import reports GEOMETRY_HOLD because a pose bounding rectangle includes another body. Original full bodies/tips look complete in private review, but this does not authorize unsafe direct rectangular cropping.
visual_limitations: Before game staging this raw needs the parent's safe pixel-preserving separation/repack and unchanged strict gate. No source pixel was edited or discarded, and no geometry exception was waived.
Maximum recoil changes projected body height through actual pitch and knee/hip articulation; do not infer a uniform scale factor from full blade/spine silhouette height.

Private source review only; runtime hit timing/readability, cross-role body calibration, actual Player/SpriteFrames connection and final actor approval remain for integration. No actor/detailed completion added.
Original tiny portrait limits exact facial/hidden-landmark judgment. Faithful canonical identity is the detailed authority; tiny-guide uncertainty alone is not automatic rejection.
